tex_content.html:
Proposition
[completeness is preserved by Riemannian coverings]

Source: petersen:page-0214 ↗ def:pet-ch5-local-isometry ↗ def:pet-ch5-geodesically-complete

1. ch5:5.6.3Let $F:(M,g_M)\to (N,g_N)$ be a Riemannian covering map. $(M,g_M)$ is geodesically complete iff $(N,g_N)$ is.
Proof

\sketch Geodesics lift uniquely through a covering, and a local isometry preserves the geodesic equation. Thus completeness of $N$ extends every lifted geodesic to all time, while completeness of $M$ pushes each all-time lift down to an extension in $N$.

□
